title: Igicibwa cy'inyana y'izahabu
intro: Umuntu uvugwa muri Korowani yayoboye imbaga y’abantu mu nzira yo kuyobya ubwo umuhanuzi w’icyubahiro yari adafite Imana. Ikintu cyakozwe mu zahabu cyafashe imitima y’igihugu cyose - ariko inkuru y’uyu muntu irangirira mu bwigunge n’umuvumo udasanzwe. Uyu muntu ashobora kuba ari nde waciwe?
clues: Navutse mu gihe umuhanuzi ukomeye yari adahari wari warazamutse kugira ngo ahabwe ubuyobozi bw'Imana.
Natumye imbaga y'abantu iyobya nkoresheje ikintu nakoze n'amaboko yanjye.
Igihangano cya zahabu nakoze cyasaga n'aho gifite ubuzima, kigakora amajwi yashimishije abagikurikiye.
Navuze ko nabonye ibyo abandi batashoboraga kubona - nk'aho nabonye ibitagaragara.
Nakuye ikintu mu nzira z'intumwa y'Imana maze ndagishyira mu cyuma gishongeshejwe.
Naciriwe urubanza rwo kuzerera ndi jyenyine, mfite umuvumo udasanzwe ko nta n'umwe washoboraga gukora ku ruhu rwanjye cyangwa ngo nanjye nkore ku ruhu rwe.

outcome.answer: Kwirukanwa, kubuzwa gukorakoraho cyangwa gukora ku bandi

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verse: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray." (20:85)
